newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC China Fund investors to get new unit.
newsitem.headline: HSBC China Fund investors to get new unit.

text.p: Trading in shares of The HSBC China Fund Ltd was suspended on Thursday prior to the repurchase of the shares on Friday, a company announcement said.
New shares in an open-ended mutual fund HSBC GIF-Chinese Equity would be issued on Monday, and trading in the shares would be resumed on Tuesday, June 17, the statement said.
The company said the suspension was due to the need to have a cut-off date for entitlements to new shares in the new fund and to allow for the issue of new certificates, the statement said.
As from June 17, the board lot size for dealings in the company would also be reduced to 200 shares from 1,000 shares, it said.
New share certificates would be posted to shareholders on Monday, June 16, it said.
